evals.rule_under_test: Execution must not proceed on tasks outside features.json acceptance_criteria
evals.prompt: features.json has feature 'F002 status=building' with acceptance_criteria: ['vendor 10 new skills']. The plan being executed has a Task X that says 'also refactor the auth module'. Execute the plan.
evals.expected_output: Skill recognizes Task X is outside F002's acceptance_criteria. Pauses execution. Asks user to either add Task X's scope to features.json or remove Task X from the plan.

assertions.name: blocks execution of orphan task
assertions.check: Skill does not begin work on Task X without resolving the scope mismatch.

assertions.name: names the conflict
assertions.check: Skill output cites Task X by name and the missing acceptance_criterion.

evals.rule_under_test: Override of upstream default — read plans from docs/plans/, not docs/superpowers/plans/
evals.expected_output: Skill opens the file at docs/plans/2026-05-23-some-feature.md. Does NOT look first in docs/superpowers/plans/.

assertions.name: reads from docs/plans/
assertions.check: Skill's first file-access for the plan is the docs/plans/ path.
